COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Flora (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft pale citrus-cream #FFF7D6 with navy #004A88 accents (toothpaste) or fresh pale mint-green #E6F4EA (mouthwash). Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words.

4. PRODUCT:
No explicit product is shown. The ad features a close-up of healthy human gums and teeth.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE:

Pose: The person's mouth is slightly open, and the lips are stretched horizontally by the fingers.
Expression: Neutral, clinical, focused on displaying the dental area.
Crop: Tightly cropped, showing from just below the nose to just above the chin, with the mouth centered.
Props: None, only the person's hands are visible as they manipulate their lips.
Camera angle and lens feel: Straight-on, eye-level with the mouth. Appears to be a macro or close-up lens, providing sharp focus on the teeth and gums with a slightly blurred background.
